# Superseded draft, do not edit

These are the ten chapters of an abandoned draft, kept only because the
correction record references them by line number.

**They are not part of the thesis.** The submitted document is built by
`main_msu.tex` from `msu_ch1_introduction.tex` through `msu_ch6_conclusion.tex`
plus the four appendices.

They also carry defects that three audits removed from the live chapters,
including the 41.4 percent exemplar rate that was struck as unmeasured, the
pre-correction architecture claims, and contaminated evaluation figures.
Copying anything from here into the live chapters would reintroduce them.
